name: tone-check
title: ToneCheck
description: Reads the tone of a draft as you type (friendly, neutral, blunt or tense, casual to formal) and offers a one-tap softer rewrite when it reads off.

files.content:
import { z } from 'zod'

export const toneSchema = z.object({
  tone: z.string(),
  formality: z.number(),
  note: z.string().default(''),
})
export type ToneOutput = z.infer<typeof toneSchema>

export { ToneCheck, toneCheckLabels, toneColor, type ToneCheckIcons, type ToneCheckLabels, type ToneCheckProps, type ToneCheckStyles, type ToneMeterProps, type ToneSuggestionProps } from './tone-check'
export { useToneCheck, type ToneCheckState, type UseToneCheckOptions } from './use-tone-check'
export { tones, tonePosition, toneSystem, softenSystem, parseToneLines, normalizeFormality, toTone, cleanSofter, type Tone, type ToneReading } from './prompts'
export { toneSchema } from './schema'

budget.strategy: The draft is truncated to half the window so the softer rewrite fits in the rest; the reading is a small JSON object.
